title: Tea Hills
hook: Meet the mist at the tea fields. Sunrise drives through Munnar's ridges.
description: Wind up through the tea estates as the fog lifts off the ridges. We time the drive for the light — Kolukkumalai and Top Station at sunrise, the Eravikulam grasslands by mid-morning, and a slow stop wherever the view earns it. A local guide who grew up on these hills rides with you, so you hear the estate stories the signboards leave out.

title: Backwaters
hook: Cruise the Alleppey backwaters aboard a traditional kettuvallam.
description: Board a traditional kettuvallam houseboat and let Alleppey and Kumarakom drift past — paddy fields below the waterline, village jetties, kingfishers on the reeds. Lunch is Kerala home cooking, cooked onboard. You set the pace: a half-day glide or an overnight with dinner under the deck lights.

title: Offbeat Trails
hook: Bike routes, waterfalls and viewpoints most tours drive straight past.
description: The roads the packaged tours skip. We map a route by bike or jeep to the waterfalls, ridge viewpoints and spice-country lanes that stay quiet because they're a little harder to reach. Flexible by design — tell us whether you want the ride, the walk, or both, and we build the day around it.
included: Route planning with a local rider
